kit-report.heading: Client report
kit-report.line: A report your client can keep: a web page, a PDF, and Word and Excel files. Every figure shows its receipt.
kit-report.manifest: List of files and their checksums
kit-report.estimates: Some lines have a number with no receipt. The report marks each one as a model estimate.
kit-report.cantSave: This browser could not save the file.
kit-report.note.hosted: A PDF needs the desktop app.
kit-report.note.hindi: The PDF could not draw Hindi on this computer, so the report is the HTML file.
kit-report.note.failed: The PDF could not be made on this computer, so the report is the HTML file.
kit-report.reason.notServed: Report links open only on the hosted Chausar with a public address. Send your client the report file yourself.
kit-report.reason.shownOnce: The link was shown once, when it was made.
kit-report.reason.disabled: You turned this link off. It no longer opens.
kit-report.reason.ended: This link has ended. Make a new link to share the report again.
kit-report.error.REPORT_BLOCK_UNSOURCED: A figure in this draft has no receipt, so the report was not made. Fix the draft, then try again.
kit-report.error.REPORT_NOT_READY: This draft has nothing to make a report from yet.
kit-report.error.REPORT_STALE: The draft changed after this report was made. Make the report again, then share it.
kit-report.error.REPORT_TOO_LARGE: This report is too large to keep. Make it with fewer files.
kit-report.error.DELIVERY_NOT_READY: Accept the draft first, then share its report.
kit-report.error.PRACTICE_DRAFT: A practice draft never goes to a client.
kit-report.error.REPORT_SHARE_DISABLED: This link is turned off. Make a new one.
kit-report.error.APP_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Share reports inside the Chausar app.
kit-report.error.TRIAL_LIMIT: A temporary business cannot share links. Add your email to keep it, then you can.
kit-report.saved: Saved the report in the folder {folder}. Chausar did not send it anywhere.
kit-report.error.CA_SIGNOFF_REQUIRED: Your CA has not signed off these papers yet, so they cannot go to your client. Share the report once your CA signs.
kit-report.error.REPORT_NOT_FOUND: That report is no longer here. Make the report again.
kit-report.error.REPORT_SHARE_NOT_FOUND: That link is no longer here. Make a new one.
kit-report.error.EXPORT_EXISTS: A folder with this report's name is already there, so Chausar left it alone. Choose another place.
kit-report.error.channel: This report has nothing from that channel. Choose from the channels listed.
